title: Pythia-1 designs full-length IgG antibodies, including GPCR agonists and antagonists
summary: Pythia-1, an all-atom generative model over sequence and 3D structure, designed full-length human IgG candidates for 22 targets including GPCRs. After one design round and screening of at most 48 candidates per target, antibodies with single-digit nanomolar affinities (soluble targets) and cell-binding EC50 values (GPCRs) were found. In vitro assays showed target engagement and single-digit nanomolar inhibitory potency for a range of targets, with biophysical profiles comparable to or better than clinical-stage controls. The authors report the first GPCR agonism and antagonism by de novo designed full-length IgG. Company preprint; in vitro only.
